data.name: Acenaphthene with Water
measurement_methods: Samples of the replicate were extracted with cyclohexane.
Standard solutions were prepared either by direct weighing using a Cahn electrobalance, or by weighing 0.1-0.2 g of samples followed by serial dilution in calibrated glassware.
mixing_methods: Approximately 20 g of (1) was placed in each of three 250-mL glass-stoppered flasks with (2).
The flasks were suspended in an open water bath and shaken gently from one to three weeks between measurements.

publication_references.citation: Wauchope, R.D.; Getzen, F.W., J. Chem. Eng. Data 1972, 17(1), 38-41.
